justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: CI auditory rehabilitation outcomes are significant for deaf populations; CISC vs non-certified comparison not available.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: CISC certification requires significant supervised clinical experience in CI programming.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable exclusively in cochlear implant programs and audiology CI specialty practices.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: CI programming and aural rehabilitation billable; CISC supports documentation for CI services; some commercial payer recognition.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Required or preferred at cochlear implant centers; limited but consistently valued.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: CI recipients highly value specialized programming expertise.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: CI mapping and rehab are largely insurance/Medicare-covered; limited cash-pay channels.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Specialty supports stronger contracts with CI centers and manufacturers.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Distinguishes audiologists/SLPs in a small, technical niche.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: CI programs can employ multiple clinicians under credentialed leadership; moderate scalability.
justifications.business.marketDemand: CI families search for experienced providers but not the specific cert by name.
justifications.business.efficiency: Specialty certification is achievable with focused clinical hours and CEUs; moderate lift.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Valued in AuD/CSD programs with CI tracks; recognized but less universal than ASHA board specialties.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Active research domain; outcomes, candidacy, pediatric CI literature.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Directly supports CI, aural rehab, and pediatric audiology coursework.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Strong evidence base; CI is one of the most-studied interventions in audiology.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Programs with CI tracks specifically seek this expertise.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Moderate cost; reasonable academic ROI in CI-focused programs.
